[中文](#cn-v0.4.3) | [English](#en-v0.4.3)

**为发布到 npm 做准备。** 目标只有一个：让这个包**在 npm 上也是体面的** ——
别让人一点开 README 就是一堆点不动的死链。

<h3 id="cn-v0.4.3">新增功能</h3>

本版**不新增功能**，只做发布准备。

<h3 id="cn-v0.4.3">体验优化</h3>

- **README 的文档链接改成 GitHub 绝对地址**（**22 条**）：`docs/*.md` / `CHANGELOG.md` / `.github/release-notes/*`
  原来是相对路径，**在 npmjs.com 上会 404**（那些文件按 `files` 不在包里，npm 也不提供文件浏览）。
  改成绝对地址后 **GitHub 与 npm 两边都能点**。页内锚点与外链未动。
- **`package.json` 的 `files` 加 `docs/` 与 `CHANGELOG.md`**：文档随包走 ——
  对一个"**给 AI 用的包**"来说，能读到的文档本身就是能力的一部分。
  打包结果 **7 文件 / 146.5 kB → 14 文件 / 186.9 kB**。

<h3 id="cn-v0.4.3">问题修复</h3>

- 无用户可见的缺陷修复。修的是**发布形态**上的问题（死链）。

<h3 id="cn-v0.4.3">其他变更</h3>

- **绊线加强（防假绿）**：README 的链接检查原来只验**相对路径**。链接改绝对之后剩下的相对链接没几条，
  这条断言会**退化成空跑** —— 所以现在**两种形态都验**：GitHub 绝对链接被映射回仓库相对路径再查存在性，
  并加一条「**确实检查到了链接（不是空跑）**」（实测 10 条）。
- **发布准备核对（都是实测）**：包名 **`dsh-lanhu` 在官方源可用**（404）· 产物**已脱敏**
  （公司名 / 账号别名 / 本机路径 / 真实 UUID 全 **0**）· 许可证 **MIT 与 `package.json` 一致** ·
  版本与 git tag 对应 · `bin` 提供 `lanhu` CLI · `optionalDependencies` 只挂 `puppeteer-core`（不装也能用）。
- ⚠️ **发布者须知**：本机 npm 的 registry 指向 `registry.npmmirror.com`（**只读镜像，发不上去**），
  所以登录与发布都要显式带上 `--registry=https://registry.npmjs.org`。

**Full Changelog**: [v0.4.2...v0.4.3](https://github.com/LoktLin/dsh-lanhu/compare/v0.4.2...v0.4.3)

---

<h3 id="en-v0.4.3">New Features</h3>

No new features — this release only prepares for publishing.

<h3 id="en-v0.4.3">Improvements</h3>

- **README documentation links converted to absolute GitHub URLs** (**22** of them): `docs/*.md`, `CHANGELOG.md` and
  `.github/release-notes/*`. As relative paths they **404 on npmjs.com** (those files are not in the tarball per `files`,
  and npm offers no file browsing). Absolute URLs work **on both GitHub and npm**. In-page anchors and external links
  were left alone.
- **`docs/` and `CHANGELOG.md` added to `package.json`'s `files`**: the docs now travel with the package — for a package
  **built for AI consumption**, readable documentation is part of the capability.
  Tarball: **7 files / 146.5 kB → 14 files / 186.9 kB**.

<h3 id="en-v0.4.3">Bug Fixes</h3>

No user-visible defects fixed. What was fixed is the **publishing shape** (dead links).

<h3 id="en-v0.4.3">Chores</h3>

- **Tripwire strengthened (against false greens)**: the README link check only verified **relative** paths. Once the links
  became absolute, few relative links remained, so the assertion would have **degenerated into a no-op** — it now verifies
  **both forms**: absolute GitHub links are mapped back to repository-relative paths and checked for existence, plus a
  "**links really were checked (this is not a no-op)**" assertion (measured: 10 links).
- **Publish readiness, all measured**: the name **`dsh-lanhu` is available** on the official registry (404) · the tarball
  **is sanitized** (company name / account aliases / local paths / real UUIDs all **0**) · the **MIT license matches
  `package.json`** · the version corresponds to the git tag · `bin` exposes the `lanhu` CLI ·
  `optionalDependencies` only lists `puppeteer-core` (usable without it).
- ⚠️ **Note for the publisher**: npm on this machine points at `registry.npmmirror.com` (a **read-only mirror — you cannot
  publish to it**), so both login and publish must pass `--registry=https://registry.npmjs.org` explicitly.

**Full Changelog**: [v0.4.2...v0.4.3](https://github.com/LoktLin/dsh-lanhu/compare/v0.4.2...v0.4.3)
